ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and remind the driver that the "I'm Here" / wait-to-cancel flow requires the full 3-minute wait at the pickup point before cancelling.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he waited more than 3 minutes, but the timeline shows 'I'm Here' pressed at 13:02:45 and cancellation at 13:05:40 — 2 min 55 s (175 s), short of the >180 s required by NS-1(iii). System records override statements. (The 4 min 30 s since driver_arrived_at does not count; the clock runs from the 'I'm Here' press.)
